name: Hrodda Oath-Witness
loreTies: Hrodda preserves the names of Titans who survive impossible Gate storms. She tests whether a mission objective is worthy of oathbound intervention but never becomes a controllable unit.
Oaths give war meaning; courage gives power form.
shortBackstory: Hrodda Oath-Witness is the Asgardian witness whose choices explain how Storm-Oath Covenant changes more than the battlefield.

chapters.title: Before the Gate Spoke
chapters.text: Hrodda Oath-Witness was important before battle records named them. As oath judge and campaign herald, Hrodda Oath-Witness learned the hidden machinery beneath Valhalla Beyond the Veil: who records law, who witnesses oath, who warns the living world, and who profits when warnings are ignored.

chapters.title: Faction Duty
chapters.text: Hrodda Oath-Witness's loyalty is tied to Asgardian culture rather than battlefield glory. Their doctrine is simple and dangerous: Oaths give war meaning; courage gives power form. The story needs them because Titans can win fights and still misunderstand what victory costs.

chapters.title: Story Arc Tie
chapters.text: During Storm-Oath Covenant, Hrodda Oath-Witness becomes a readable witness to campaign consequence. Their first appearance, Campaign 01: The First Reopening, places them where player decisions need interpretation, warning, and memory instead of another controllable unit.

chapters.title: Conflict Wound
chapters.text: The Gate pressures Hrodda Oath-Witness through knowledge. It offers signs that are useful but incomplete, trying to turn witness into accomplice. Their recurring conflict is whether to reveal truth early and risk panic, or wait for proof and risk lives.

chapters.title: Dashboard Role
chapters.text: As a non-playable character, Hrodda Oath-Witness belongs under Characters and Character Backstories. Their profile should be read beside campaign dialogue, codex unlocks, and faction pages so every briefing feels like canon consequence, not tutorial flavor.

developmentStatus: Readable NPC profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
